## Problem

What you cannot do today, and who is affected.

## Proposal

How it should work. If it touches the dashboard YAML format, sketch the YAML.

## Which roadmap feature does it relate to?

Reference `docs/roadmap/00_roadmap.md` (e.g. F2.4) or say it is new.

## Does it need something from skifer?

If yes, reference or propose an `SK-xx` entry in `docs/roadmap/00_attendus_skifer.md`.
